content:
eli: FYI, ran into a blocker while testing the new JS/TS SDK sample on Cloudflare Workers. Importing `@redwood-inference/sdk` pulls the CJS build and Workers throws "require is not defined".

noor: Yup, I hit the same on Vercel Edge. Our package.json probably resolves to cjs for the root export. Edge runtimes need the `import` path to point at esm.

frank: Also spotted a typing gap: editors don't pick up our types when consumers import via conditional exports. VS Code shows no completions for the edge sample.

anya: And a weird runtime split: Node path uses our node-fetch wrapper which retries on 502, but the ESM/edge path falls back to a fetch polyfill with its own retry. Effectively two retry layers in some call flows. Seen doubled requests in logs.

eli: Minimal repro attached in CI log (examples/edge-probe). dev-bot: paste

dev-bot: CI #5102 - examples/edge-probe build
```
Error: ReferenceError: require is not defined
 at file:///home/runner/work/examples/dist/edge/index.js:8:1
```

noor: Proposal (low friction):
1) Build from single TS sources -> outputs: `dist/esm`, `dist/cjs`, `dist/types` (emitDeclarationOnly for d.ts).
2) package.json: keep top-level "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" and add exports map:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
This makes ESM consumers (and edge bundlers) prefer the ESM entry.

frank: For editors, add a `types` field inside the ESM build package? Also recommend adding a `typesVersions` map for TS <=4.0 consumers. Some IDEs still rely on legacy resolution for conditional exports.

anya: For retry: extract a runtime-agnostic retry core in `packages/sdk-core/src/retry.ts` that receives a `fetchLike` param. Node entry points bind `undici` (or node-fetch) and edge leaves global fetch. That centralizes backoff and prevents double-retries.

noor: CI/QA changes: add a smoke example `examples/edge-smoke` which is deployed in CI to both Vercel and Workers (deploy preview + quick request). Also add a unit test that runs `esbuild --format=esm` against our package to catch bundler pitfalls.

eli: Action items:
- noor: PR with package.json exports/types change + updated README for edge sample (w/ repro removed)
- anya: refactor retry/core wrapper + tests + link to PR
- frank: add typesVersions and editor smoke to the devex checklist
- dev-bot: add CI matrix for examples/edge-smoke on Vercel & Workers

dev-bot: created issue #1041 "edge-esm-cjs-typings-retry-parity" labels: sdk, infra, bug

frank: quick note: keep single package.json. Adding package.edge.json increases publishing complexity. Better to solve with conditional exports and clear docs.

noor: Agreed. We'll also add a tiny note to the publish playbook: "verify `import` resolves to dist/esm for edge samples".

eli: I'll shepherd the PRs and ping for design review on the exports mapping. If anyone wants to pair on the esbuild smoke test, ping me.
